description: THE SECTION MAP — the one owner of which section of the site owns which route. One host; three sections — use, build, core — each with its own landing page, its own chrome, and its own FAQ; the home page (/) is the router and belongs to no section. `routes` is a longest-prefix table: [prefix, [sections]]; the FIRST section listed owns the route (its chrome, its FAQ), the rest also show the route in their nav (a shared surface). `/` is matched exactly. Read by lib/shared/sections.ts (chrome and nav) and scripts/lint-section-map.sh (every page route must map). `landings` names each section's landing page.
